name: Berliner Hütte
description: Historic mountain refuge in the Zillertal Alps and a major overnight stop on the Berliner Höhenweg.

name: Bremer Hütte
description: High alpine hut in the Stubai Alps serving the western stages of the Stubaier Höhenweg.

name: Dortmunder Hütte
description: Road-accessible hut above Kühtai at the eastern end of the Sellrainer Hüttenrunde.

name: Dresdner Hütte
description: Stubai Alps hut near the glacier ski area and a central stop on the Stubaier Höhenweg.

name: Franz-Senn-Hütte
description: Large alpine hut in the Oberbergtal used as a gateway to Stubai glacier terrain.

name: Friesenberghaus
description: Zillertal Alps hut above the Schlegeis reservoir with links toward Olpererhütte and Gamshütte.

name: Furtschaglhaus
description: Remote Zillertal Alps hut above the Schlegeis valley on the route toward Berliner Hütte.

name: Gamshütte
description: Mountain hut above Finkenberg and a common starting lodge for the Berliner Höhenweg.

name: Greizer Hütte
description: Zillertal Alps refuge in the Floitengrund between Berliner Hütte and Kasseler Hütte.

name: Innsbrucker Hütte
description: Stubai Alps hut below the Habicht and the southern endpoint of the Stubaier Höhenweg.

name: Karl-von-Edel-Hütte
description: Hut above Mayrhofen marking the eastern end of the Berliner Höhenweg.

name: Kasseler Hütte
description: Zillertal Alps hut in the Stillup valley on the high route toward Karl-von-Edel-Hütte.

name: Neue Regensburger Hütte
description: Quiet Stubai Alps hut above the Falbesoner valley between Franz-Senn-Hütte and Dresdner Hütte.

name: Nürnberger Hütte
description: Traditional Stubai Alps hut on the route from Sulzenau Hütte toward Bremer Hütte.

name: Olpererhütte
description: Popular Zillertal Alps hut overlooking the Schlegeis reservoir below the Olperer.

name: Pforzheimer Hütte
description: Sellrain mountain hut in the Gleirschtal and a key stop on the Sellrainer Hüttenrunde.

name: Potsdamer Hütte
description: Sellrain Alps hut above the Fotschertal and a common entry point to the hut circuit.

name: Schweinfurter Hütte
description: Sellrain mountain hut in the Zwieselbachtal between Pforzheimer Hütte and Dortmunder Hütte.

name: Starkenburger Hütte
description: Stubai Alps hut above Neustift with wide valley views and access to the Stubaier Höhenweg.

name: Sulzenau Hütte
description: Stubai Alps hut below the Sulzenauferner and a short stage from Dresdner Hütte.

name: Westfalenhaus
description: Sellrain Alps hut in the Längental connecting Potsdamer Hütte with several route variants.

name: Winnebachseehütte
description: Alpine hut above the Winnebachsee used by the higher variant of the Sellrainer Hüttenrunde.
